title: Stainless-steel-coil solution treatment: tipping, handling and furnace-batch records
summary: A 2021 Suneng stainless-steel coil solution-treatment proposal turns horizontal incoming coils upright, then transfers them through conveyors, a loading/unloading table and a fork vehicle into a working furnace. After heating, they move to a water tank. Batches of 2–4 coils pass several handovers, so orientation, position and material identity must stay aligned for process records to identify the actual coils.
